admission: Root applied collector/engine named gate, dependencies, default and bulk exclusions during review; check install and canonical admission remain root-owned.

primary_documentation.evidence: config.dagGcsPrefix is output-only and denotes the simulated directory prefix containing environment DAG objects. Native environment name binds project/location/environment.
GET objects.list supports prefix, maxResults and pageToken; absence of nextPageToken terminates listing. No delimiter or glob filter excludes nested objects here.
GET metadata and alt=media select the listed immutable generation and require ifGenerationMatch; existing reader validates metadata identity plus media generation/type/size.
Bucket.projectNumber is the owning project number; the independent CRM v3 Project.name carries that number.
CRM Project.name=projects/{project_number}, together with projectId, binds selected ID or numeric scope.

native_boundary.source: Complete current native composer_environment inventory and source GET receipts with no fields mask; config/name masks fail closed.
native_boundary.ownership: CRM v3 project name/projectId and native bucket projectNumber agree; all three parent rows carry real complete native GET receipts. Project ID and numeric aliases are accepted only after independent CRM proof.
native_boundary.prefix: Strict gs://bucket/nonempty/path; canonical trailing slash prevents sibling prefix matches. URLs, percent encodings, traversal, control characters and external/cross-project buckets are refused.
native_boundary.reads: Dedicated uncached bounded prefix list; per-file generation metadata and media reuse gcp_selected_object_secret_indicators._read/_metadata/_text and the same transport state/call/byte/deadline lock.
native_boundary.selection: Boolean content_secret_scans plus exact named-check planner kind. Adapter disabled/unselected returns no rows and performs no list/media/auth/scanner calls.
native_boundary.concurrent_provenance: Only exact scope plus this owner list identity or exact attempted file identity receipts are attributed; failed own reads retained. Consumer requires three native authority refs and exact own list/metadata/media receipt coverage; foreign refs fail UNKNOWN.

limits.shared_transport: Native transport max_calls, timeout, absolute deadline, deadline_seconds and cancellation also apply; every raw read tightens the remaining real socket timeout.
limits.detectors: Kingfisher 1.4.0 and TruffleHog 3.92.5; shared scan_content; offline/no verification/no updates; at most min(5,remaining/2) seconds per detector.

coverage.text: Regular UTF8 with supported text media type; gzip/archive signatures, binary/control characters, encrypted objects and unsupported representations yield UNKNOWN.
coverage.negative: PASS requires nonempty complete bounded listing, all listed supported generations completely read, both detectors complete for every file, and bound receipts. PASS covers only observed prefix generations; concurrent mutations and other environment surfaces are excluded.
unsupported: Empty prefix (UNKNOWN; not a detector-backed negative)
Directory placeholder objects or unsupported extensions/media types
Archives, dependencies, bytecode, links, binary and customer-encrypted objects
Composer APIs returning masked/incomplete/malformed native fields
Changes after the observed generation listing; no atomic whole-prefix snapshot
Plugins, data/log folders and objects outside config.dagGcsPrefix
No DAG execution, imports, package installs or managed-secret reads

privacy.retained: Environment owner, selected scope, opaque owner/file identities, immutable selector hashes, bounded byte counts, static reason codes, engine statuses and keyed redacted leak fingerprints/positions.
privacy.not_retained: DAG source, raw/sensitive filenames, cursors, provider error bodies/snippets, authentication headers or source base64 in snapshots/evidence/cache/fixtures.
privacy.logging: Source reads refuse urllib3 DEBUG or stdlib HTTP debug diagnostics; no process-wide logging configuration change.
privacy.dedup: Shared exact-value keyed fingerprints merge across both engines, files and owners. Opaque file positions preserve distinct occurrences; shared finding merger emits one hidden finding per exact leak.
